description: This Java class defines a fragment for a read-only note view in an Android application, extending a note preview fragment and overriding methods to disable editing and interaction features.

classes.name: NoteReadonlyFragment
classes.description: A fragment representing a read-only view of a note, disabling editing and interaction options.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Overrides menu preparation to hide all menu items related to editing, sharing, and other interactions.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Creates and initializes the view for the fragment, disabling content editing and swipe refresh.

methods.name: registerInternalNoteLinkHandler
methods.description: Overrides to do nothing, as internal note link handling is disabled.

methods.name: showEditTitleDialog
methods.description: Overrides to do nothing, preventing editing of the note title.

methods.name: onCloseNote
methods.description: Overrides to do nothing, as closing the note does not trigger any action.

methods.name: saveNote
methods.description: Overrides to do nothing, preventing saving changes in read-only mode.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Factory method to create a new instance of NoteReadonlyFragment with provided content.
